8.6 Working from Home. If a staff member works from home whether at the request of GESCI or of the staff member with GESCI’s consent then their home is regarded as a location of work which comes within the scope of the OSHA. So the policies and requirements set out in this document apply to home-workers just as they do to office-based staff.
